close_reason: folded into fz-sc8.64: the check can only be green once .64 rewrites the twelve silent oracles, so the two are one step
description: For an expect: abort oracle fixture, expected.txt is Elixir's combined output (the oracle rescues and prints Exception.format_banner), and the fz paths prove their rejection through expected.stderr, which the matrix only checks as a substring of fz's stderr. Nothing ties the two files together: a hand-written expected.stderr that Elixir never printed passes. Close the loop in tests/fixture_matrix.rs: when an abort fixture has an oracle, expected.stderr must be a substring of expected.txt, so the pinned fz failure line is provably Elixir's text. Applies to 00702-00718 today and to every lib panic site fz-sc8.64 renames (00617-00639 and new fixtures). Red first: a fixture whose expected.stderr is not in its expected.txt fails with a message naming both files.
title: An abort fixture's stderr golden is a substring of its oracle's expected.txt
